summary: Independent verification of both client-reported bug fixes on ARC.LAB landing page (frontend only). BUG 1 (Metodo player foot cut): PASS at 1440x900 and 1280x800 — metodo-player bottom equals metodo-section bottom exactly (overflow_below=0.0), width preserved at 480px, horizontal position preserved (left ≈ 760px @1440, ≈ 668px @1280). BUG 2 (Cambios background textures): PASS at 1440x900 — left texture (/images/hero-cutout.png) anchored at left=0/bottom=0 with object-fit:cover, object-position:50% 0%; right texture (/images/metodo-cutout.png) anchored at right=0/top=0 with object-fit:cover, object-position:50% 50%; both with opacity=0.05. No negative margins detected, subjects not cut in half. All 4 Cambios cells (cambios-item-1..4) remain clickable and behave exclusively (opening item 2 collapses item 1: item1 goes 226→334→226px, item2 goes 226→226→306px). No horizontal scroll at 1440x900, 1280x800, or 375x700.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes independently confirmed via getBoundingClientRect + getComputedStyle. Metodo player overflow=0 (exact fit) at 1440 and 1280. Cambios images both opacity 0.05, cover, anchored corners. Exclusive-accordion behavior on cambios-item-1..4 works. Note: cell aria-expanded stays 'false' (not toggled) — behavior driven by height/state, not aria; consider improving a11y but not a blocker.
